guide.description: Choose Giant, Goblin or Robot. Play Pitch, Size and Texture, then compare with your original.

controls.action: Choose a voice. Tap the selected name and icon to reset its three sound controls.
Pitch: lower or higher. Size: large or small vocal tract. Texture: soft or rough; electronic strength for Robot.
Compare and return. Start, Cancel or Retry appears here before Live.
Change Pitch / return to the voice’s starting pitch. Robot changes its electronic carrier.
Change Size over a wide range / return to the voice’s starting size. Pitch stays independent.
Change Texture from soft to rough / return to the voice’s starting texture. Robot changes electronic strength.
Change Output / return to 85%, including during original comparison.
Previous / next voice. Returning recalls Pitch, Size and Texture for this launch.
Shared Guide, audio routes, Device settings and Exit.

sections.title: Audio and saved settings
sections.text: Echo cancellation defaults ON in Menu → Device → Audio; your choice is remembered. Preview never captures a microphone: choose Listen to preview, then Demo. Voice, Pitch, Size, Texture, Output and comparison save automatically; other voices’ adjustments last for this launch. Original comparison shares timing and output volume. Goblin preserves high-band articulation during large pitch changes.
